youtube_description:
Jesus... why do my parents only fight when they think I'm asleep?

His parents only fight when they think he's asleep. He lies there with earphones in and no music playing, just listening.

Him: Jesus... why do my parents only fight when they think I'm asleep?

Him: I lie there with my earphones in, but there's no music playing. I'm just listening.

Jesus: You're listening because you're trying to protect everyone. That's a lot to carry at night.

Him: If I was a better son, maybe they wouldn't be so stressed all the time.

Jesus: Their fight is not your fault. You didn't start it, and it's not your job to end it.

Him: But what if one day one of them just packs a bag and leaves?

Jesus: I can't promise every night will be quiet. I can promise you won't face any of it alone. Give Me the part you can't fix.

"You will keep in perfect peace those whose minds are steadfast, because they trust in you."
Isaiah 26:3 (NIV)

Jesus: Tonight, put the music on for real. Let Me keep watch for a while.

Jesus's Replies — the questions you actually ask, answered in His words.
